title: GS21 with the investment cost dependent on LEVERAGE and the priced state: cost x exp(-0.2 b~ y), one type, GS21's own debt dynamics
question: Does a y exposure that is the product of the firm's leverage and its investment option make room in GS21, where the level investment-cost exposure (gvyi25) left 1%?
notes:
SECOND RETRY (2026-10-29 01:20) at gs_bib -0.2. Both -1.0 (gvyib) and -0.5 (gvyib5) diverged at the SAME exponential rate (qerr 1e52 by sweep ~3200), while a probe at 0.0 and -0.01 converged like gvyi25 (qerr 0.41 / 0.24 / 0.14 at sweeps 200/400/600), so the gs_bib code path is sound and the divergence is economic: the firm chooses the coupon that makes the investment cost multiplier small in the current state (min e^{-|gs_bib| 1.72 x 2.5}: 0.013 at -1.0, 0.12 at -0.5) and invests with certainty, and the value iteration explodes. At -0.2 the cheapest multiplier is 0.42.

WHY (2026-10-28, user request). gvyi25 put y on every firm's investment cost (room 1%: the option is a small share of GS21 equity and the exposure is a level). Here the cost multiplier is exp(gs_bib b~ y) with gs_bib = -0.5 (gvyib's -1.0 diverged): a levered firm finds investment dear when y is low, an unlevered firm cheap, so the exposure through the option is leverage times the option's value, with a cross-sectional mean near zero. New solver / simulator knob gs_bib (2026-10-28), inert at 0: the (NY,) cost multiplier cy becomes (NY, bnum) over the CURRENT coupon, broadcast in the investment cutoffs; the simulator pays icost x exp((gs_bi + gs_bib b~(b_t)) y). One type, no level compensation (nothing to hide at y = 0).

PREDICTION (2026-10-28): room 1 to 5% of the linear ceiling, no gap: the option is too small a share of GS21 equity for its exposure to matter, and leverage is now an observed characteristic.
